traits.leaf_arrangement.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae and Phyllanthaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly alternate; DELTA Guttiferae: mostly opposite. Opposite in Clusiaceae, Hypericaceae, Calophyllaceae, Malpighiaceae, Rhizophoraceae (~3,500 of ~16,000 spp.), hence 'sometimes'.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae (read 2026-10-16): spiral or distichous; DELTA Chrysobalanaceae and Erythroxylaceae: spiral (mostly). Weighting by Euphorbiaceae; opposite-leaved families overridden to decussate.

traits.leaf_division.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves usually simple, palmate when compound; Phyllanthaceae, Chrysobalanaceae, Erythroxylaceae simple.

traits.division_pattern.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae (read 2026-10-16): compound leaves palmate (Hevea, Manihot, Ricinus lobing); Passiflora lobing palmate (my knowledge); Ochnaceae pinnate rarely.

traits.rosette.note: DELTA pages read (2026-10-16) describe trees, shrubs, leafy herbs; rosettes only in some Viola and Achariaceae (both state their own).

traits.life_span.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae/Phyllanthaceae (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs, herbs; annuals in Euphorbia, Phyllanthus, Linum, Viola, Elatine. 'usually' is my weighting (mostly woody tropical order).

traits.inflorescence.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae (read 2026-10-16): ultimate units nearly always cymose; DELTA Phyllanthaceae: axillary thyrses or glomerules; DELTA Erythroxylaceae: axillary fascicles.

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Phyllanthaceae and Erythroxylaceae (read 2026-10-16): axillary; DELTA Euphorbiaceae: terminal or axillary; DELTA Guttiferae: terminal. Weighting is mine.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae, Phyllanthaceae, Erythroxylaceae (read 2026-10-16): regular; DELTA Chrysobalanaceae: usually irregular; Violaceae and many Malpighiaceae zygomorphic.

traits.hypanthium.note: DELTA Chrysobalanaceae (read 2026-10-16): free tubular hypanthium, unusual in the order; Euphorbiaceae, Phyllanthaceae none. Passifloraceae and Rhizophoraceae overridden.

traits.ovary_position.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae, Phyllanthaceae (read 2026-10-16): superior; half-inferior or inferior only in Rhizophoraceae and some Dichapetalaceae/Achariaceae (they state it).

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Malpighiales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): gynoecium often of three carpels.

traits.fruit_type.note: DELTA Euphorbiaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly dry schizocarpic/capsular fruits; Phyllanthaceae capsule, berry or drupe; Chrysobalanaceae and Erythroxylaceae drupes.
